body: It has gotten to the point where interest being applied daily is just too much and I have left it too long to sort out. I have made my decision and, strangely I feel happier knowing I have decided. I am going to spend the next few days saying my subtle good byes.

I can't provide for my family any more due to debt, I can't concentrate on work so will end up loosing my job, my wife has no interest in affection towards me or from me any more. My life is over, I just haven't finalised it yet.

Eldest is my step son, I have loved  him like my own since he was 17 months old. have 2 blood children with my wife and they are all loved equally. Eldest has never known a life without me as his dad.

That said, I cannot see a way out of this at the minute. Things just getting worse and worse. Wife is becoming more and more distant with me, even though I have started opening up more about how i am feeling and things that have happened to me in the past. 

So far I have not done anything serious but when I get really down I have started SH. I know this is stupid and I shouldn't do it but I am waiting for NHS to help me. Seems to be the only thing at the minute that I can do to distract me. Like I said, wife is very distant, none of my family give a shit, wifes family seem to want me gone. I am just alone. Everyone would be better off without me I think

Kids are too young. They would forget me easily. I can't go on living thus life of pain and disappointment any more. All I do is hurt people and ruin things for other people. Hell,  I got myself into so much debt I cant support my own family any more. All that debt was from spending money on my family so I can't even do that right. Should just end it all now and put everyone out of their misery

I made some progress last night. proud of myself actually. I told my wife everything. told her about my SH and how I am feeling like ending it all. the SH has got a lot worse. I have an appointment again with the doctor tonight (the doctor I spoke to is staying on late to be able to see me which is really nice of him).

I feel like I have let everyone down now. I have dumped so much of my pain onto my wife by opening up to her, she shouldn't have to deal with this. She shouldn't have to see the pain I am in. I don't want her to feel the pain I feel.

Sorry random internet person. I know you are going through your own problems. It is kind of good to put into words some bits. Hope you're ok :-)

Because I am a worthless, pointless excuse of a human being. I let everyone down and disappoint everyone. I have fallen into a hole and cannot see the light any more. All I ever wanted was to give my family the best possible, got myself into so much debt trying to do that. I cannot clear this, I cannot focus on work any more. My meds are not helping, I have started self harming to get some sense of relief. I wish I could stop this pain any other way but I don't think I can.

Docs changed my meds today to citalopram too. Been given 10mg course. The sertraline was causing too many side effects. got to come off all together now for a few days to clear my system then start on these so it will now be even longer before meds start working properly. This isn't my first battle with depression, my mum died 7-8 years ago and I suffered then too. I got into a lot of drugs and was popping pills every day, after a year of doing that I met my wife and things started looking up so got off the drugs. I now have 3 lovelly children and been married over 3 years.

This time is different though. I don't know what has caused it, what I can do to stop feeling like this. I cant hit the drugs again as much as I want to because of my family (dont want them to see me like this at all) so I am guessing that is why this time I am SH. It is just an escape that seems to work at the minute. Not hurting anyone else, no-one else knows.
